items.title: Inspect F-009 original claim and current proof surfaces
items.context: Use Lattice CLI and source/doc reads to compare the open F-009 claim with current Layer2 formal proof/evaluator behavior. Do not edit code.
items.userSees: Audit evidence lists the original F-009 claim and current Layer2 formal proof surfaces with source/doc references.

happy.desc: finding_list shows F-009 original open high/suspected claim and source/doc rg commands identify current formal proof surfaces.

edge.desc: The audit distinguishes formal Layer2 proof path from local diagnostic commands and from Layer4 Authority/customerKeyRef scope.

adversarial.desc: If only docs claim a proof path but source lacks fail-closed checks, CHK-001 must not be considered done.

verificationEvidence.note: Confirmed original F-009 was open/high/suspected and claimed no verified non-local capability proof producer/import path exists.
Docs distinguish Layer2 formal proof, current LOCKED/PASS semantics, and separate Layer4 customerKeyRef/Authority scope.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "writeFormalBaselineReport|localOnly=true diagnostic final-report cannot authorize suite proof|formalSuiteRevalidationProblems|evaluateFormalEngineeringClaim" packages/main/src/core/lattice-baseline.ts && npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Source and smoke test evidence show the formal path exists and local-only/forged/stale/higher-layer overclaim paths fail closed.

items.title: Decide F-009 closure state with evidence
items.context: Determine whether F-009 is resolved, superseded, or should be narrowed. The decision must distinguish Layer2 Engineering proof from Layer4/Authority/customerKeyRef scope.
items.userSees: A recorded decision explains whether F-009 is resolved, superseded, narrowed, or still open, without merging Layer2 and Layer4 scope.

happy.desc: Decision evidence identifies whether the original no-producer/importer claim is stale or still true.

edge.desc: Any remaining customerKeyRef or Authority receipt concern is classified as Layer4 future/blocked scope, not as the original F-009 Layer2 gap.

adversarial.desc: If source evidence shows local diagnostic artifacts can still unlock Layer2, the decision must keep or narrow F-009 instead of resolving it.

verificationEvidence.command: two-host audit lanes plus local source/doc inspection; lattice capability_claim_formal_evaluate --target=engineering --format=json
verificationEvidence.note: Combined audit decision: original no-producer/importer claim is stale because formal writer/suite/evaluator path exists; current claim remains LOCKED due missing baseline-suite-report artifacts, which is expected fail-closed behavior, not a Layer2 proof-path absence.
Remaining customerKeyRef coverage is documented as future Layer4 evidence scope and must not be treated as current implemented support or folded into F-009.
Evaluator returned authorized=false, outcome=EXPECTED_BLOCK, layer2EngineeringClaim=LOCKED, and Production/global claims LOCKED when proof artifacts are missing; no fake unlock was observed.

items.title: Update B-META finding state through Lattice finding flow
items.context: Use finding_resolve, finding_dismiss, or an equivalent Lattice finding command only after evidence supports the decision. Do not mutate B-META files directly.
items.userSees: B-META-framework-audit:F-009 state is updated only through a Lattice finding command, with resolution text that names source evidence and boundaries.

happy.desc: finding_resolve or equivalent Lattice command updates F-009 with evidence-backed resolution text.

edge.desc: The resolution does not mark Layer4 customerKeyRef, Production Safety, global Capability, productionDone, or fullAuthorityDone as complete.

adversarial.desc: Direct file mutation or unsupported status edits fail this checklist item even if the visible text looks correct.

verificationEvidence.note: F-009 was resolved through the Lattice finding flow in the B-META main-shared audit container, then merged into B-9833; no direct B-META file mutation was used.

ResolvedReason explicitly says this is not a Layer2 capability unlock and keeps Layer4 customerKeyRef, Production Safety, global claim, receiptVerified, productionDone, and fullAuthorityDone outside this resolution.

verificationEvidence.command: lattice finding_resolve attempted from DEV worktree before REVIEW/main-shared handling
verificationEvidence.note: The first DEV-phase attempt was rejected by Lattice phase policy, proving unsupported status mutation was not silently accepted.

items.title: Verify convergence and audit backlog after F-009 triage
items.context: Run convergence_check, finding_list, and gap_analyze. Success means F-009 no longer remains a vague open high/suspected finding; any remaining high gap is explicitly scoped.
items.userSees: Verification output shows F-009 is no longer an open vague high/suspected advisory, and any remaining high gap is explicitly scoped outside this story.

happy.desc: finding_list confirms F-009 is resolved/dismissed/narrowed according to the recorded decision.

edge.desc: gap_analyze may still report customerKeyRef, but it must be clearly scoped to Layer4 future/blocked work rather than this F-009 closure.

adversarial.desc: convergence output must not be presented as fully clean if active stories or unrelated high gaps remain.

auditLog.reason: Recorded audit evidence for original F-009 claim and current formal proof surfaces.
Recorded evidence-backed decision to resolve the original stale F-009 gap while preserving locked capability boundaries.
Prepare for REVIEW-phase finding_resolve, since Lattice correctly gates finding_resolve out of DEV.
F-009 state was updated through Lattice finding_resolve with claim-boundary evidence.
